_source: The Heli's rotor (documents 63, 79, 85): the object the Heli descriptor's next-link points at (0x440708). Transcribed from the port's former hard-coded constants (game/vehicle_render_3d.gd), which were traced from FUN_00403350 / 0x403420 and the corner sets at 0x4405a0 and 0x4406c0; not re-read from the binary when it moved into the definition (step 5).
